# Object-Store (ONTAP REST API 9.16, GET only)

> Source: NetApp's **ontap-mcp** API catalog for **ONTAP 9.16** (github.com/NetApp/ontap-mcp, Apache-2.0, see NOTICE.md). It lists **GET endpoints only**, with their filters and fields. Everything here is `[doc]` for reads on ONTAP 9.16; a field marked *since X* doesn't exist before ONTAP X. For writes (POST/PATCH/DELETE), use the cluster's own spec (README.md, *Full API locally*). ## GET `/api/protocols/s3/buckets`

**Tier:** T0 · **since ONTAP** 9.7

Retrieves all S3 buckets for all SVMs. Note that in order to retrieve S3 bucket policy conditions, the 'fields' option should be set to '**'. ### Related ONTAP commands * `vserver object-store-server
